typography.instructions: E1 ANTI-DEFAULT RULE: Do NOT use Inter for headings. Keep leading loose for body (leading-relaxed) to aid elderly readers. Ensure tight tracking on headings. Implement fluid scaling for large displays.

colors.instructions: Clinical palette (Archetype: Health/Trust) focusing on calm, soft blues and greens on pure white. Avoid teal-green per E1 rules. Do not use pure black; use tinted slates. Ensure WCAG AA contrast (min 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text/interactive elements). Hover state color MUST be a darker/lighter hue explicitly set.

layouts.driver_app: Mobile-first layout. E1 Space Rule: Generous spacing. Use large tap targets (min h-14, min-w-[44px]). Sticky bottom action bar with massive primary button (w-full). Cards need p-6 for touch-friendly breathing room.
layouts.facility_portal: Standard sidebar layout. Max-w-7xl content area. Form inputs must be large (h-12) with explicit labels above, left-aligned. No placeholder-only labels.
layouts.dispatch_console: High Density Grid Protocol. Full-width desktop Kanban (7 columns). Horizontal scroll allowed. Tight gap (gap-4) but generous padding inside cards. Use shape-coded markers for custody timeline.
layouts.admin_center: High-density data tables. Sticky headers. Use striped rows for readability. Action menus on the far right.
layouts.spacing_scale: Tailwind Scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Prioritize generous spacing (e.g., gap-6 or gap-8) between discrete sections. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm). DO NOT USE GLASSMORPHISM for medical context (prevents data refraction).
surfaces.modals: Opaque white background with dark semi-transparent backdrop (bg-slate-900/60). No backdrop-blur for clinical/health apps.
surfaces.headers: Solid white with a crisp 1px border-b (border-slate-200). Never transparent over content.

motion.instructions: Minimalist and purposeful. Micro-interactions for hover states (e.g., -translate-y-1 on cards, subtle shadow-md). Transitions MUST specify properties (transition-transform, transition-colors), never 'transition-all'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA adherence. Interactive elements must have 3:1 against background. Text must have 4.5:1.
accessibility.touch_targets: Driver app buttons/links MUST be at least 44x44px. Use min-h-[56px] for primary mobile actions.
accessibility.visual_cues: Do not rely on color alone for status; use shape-coded icons (e.g., Triangle for warning, Circle for success, Hexagon for critical).
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements and key information displays MUST include semantic data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='driver-accept-job-button').

medical_courier_box.description: Masked delivery service handling a secure parcel. Use for driver app onboarding or facility portal landing.

courier_handover.description: Delivery professional handing secure package inside building. Use for signature capture flow or recipient tracking page.

lab_professional.description: Scientist in clinical laboratory. Use for facility portal login/marketing.

lab_worker_blood_sample.description: Healthcare worker examining sample. Great for facility portal booking empty states or marketing.

ontario_cityscape.description: Toronto/Ontario skyline. Use as a subtle background for the public recipient delivery page or main landing page hero.

media.instructions: Replace all food-delivery stock imagery with the provided clinical/medical transport visuals. Do not use generic placeholders. Add descriptive alt text for screen readers.

components.buttons: Rounded-xl for clinical/friendly touch (avoids harsh corners). Driver app primary CTA MUST span full width on mobile (w-full h-14 text-lg).
components.inputs: Height 12 (h-12) or 14 (h-14) for driver app. Strong border (border-slate-300). Focus states MUST have ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1.
components.badges: Use for status ('In Transit', 'Delivered'). Must include dot or icon + text. Example: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1.
components.tables: Admin/Facility tables should use customized Shadcn Table. Ensure row hover states (hover:bg-slate-50) and generous cell padding (p-4).
components.kanban: Dispatch board columns: bg-slate-50/50 rounded-xl p-3. Kanban Cards: bg-white shadow-sm border border-slate-200. Cards MUST show custody timeline via distinct vertical line or step indicator.

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for clinical, clean aesthetic. Use larger stroke widths (stroke-width 2.5) and larger sizes (w-6 h-6 or w-8 h-8) for driver app icons to improve visibility outdoors.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep minimal for clinical trust. DO NOT USE noisy gradients. Flat solid colors prioritize legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: For the driver app, heavily prioritize mobile-first classes. Implement a sticky bottom bar with massive touch targets.
Never use generic centered layouts for data or forms; left-align for clinical readability.
Apply all colors as Tailwind arbitrary values or mapped CSS variables (e.g., text-slate-900, bg-[#0369a1]) to incrementally upgrade the UI without breaking existing class references.
Ensure 'Ontario\'s Medical Transport Network' identity and MediTrans logo (text or SVG) is in the top-left of all headers.
Include data-testid on every single interactive element (button, link, form input, checkbox, modal trigger, tab) WITHOUT EXCEPTION.
Implement the Dispatch Kanban with CSS Grid/Flex, ensuring it scrolls horizontally if needed while keeping 7 columns fixed width.
Avoid glassmorphism globally. Use flat, solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of clinical data.
Ensure large legible type support (text-base or text-lg minimum for recipient pages, suitable for elderly users).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements using solid borders and ambient shadows rather than glassmorphism. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Every interaction needs micro-animations (e.g., hover states, transitions for inputs, excluding transforms from universal transition). Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl) with interaction animations. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds under content. Provide toast notifications via Sonner for critical actions.
